blockedBy: Starts after the Pets and Farm Update (you said: the update after next)
body:
You OK'd every move (31 Oct). Polishing waits for the update after next.
List to polish (from the checks):
- Clips that jump back when they restart.
- People and pets on stairs (no knees: people hop each step, the dog tips up).
- Hands that stop short (milking, eggs, Sir Barkley's card).
- Owl perch inside the leaves, seal bigger than its slide, monkey head at the bar.
- Cow head still a box shape; capybara tub, monkey shows its back.
- Horse stops at the stall gate; milk hard to see.
- New joints from the Living chat to use: duck and owl wing flaps, snake tongue flick.
